_comment: How each reader decodes ctf:admin:settings.secureDevTargets. Run verbatim by apps/web/src/lib/__tests__/secure-dev-targets.test.ts (normalizeSecureDevTargets) and sync/test/redis.test.js (getSecureDevTargets). The two readers fail in OPPOSITE directions on purpose: the app only DISPLAYS targets, so anything it cannot use reads as 'default' (all six, the fresh-box answer); the poller decides what SCORES, so anything it cannot use is 'refuse' (skip the tick and log why) rather than a guess. Where both accept a list they must agree on it exactly, in catalogue order. raw null means the field is absent. app: a list, or "default". sync: a list, "all" (every target), or "refuse".

cases.description: empty string is absent, not an empty selection
stored order is not returned order: catalogue order wins
unknown ids are dropped when a known one survives
a JSON object, not an array
a bare JSON string, not an array
